assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production character-creation customization atlas for a browser monster-tamer game. Primary request: Create a new 3 columns by 3 rows atlas of the exact Apprentice dagger character from the reference, shown full-body in the same polished hand-painted chibi fantasy game-art style. This is a customization preview, not an animation sheet. Input image: reference image establishes the character identity, cream apprentice tunic, dark trousers, boots, proportions, rendering quality, and worn dagger. Grid specification: exactly nine equally sized cells. Columns from left to right are expressions: calm (gentle neutral mouth and eyes), bright (warm open smile), focused (determined brows and closed mouth). Rows from top to bottom are hairstyles: short textured crop, side-swept medium hair matching the reference, and a clear long side braid. Every cell must match its requested row hairstyle and column expression. Pose: the same relaxed three-quarter standing pose facing slightly right in all nine cells, dagger held safely down at the side, both feet visible, consistent scale and foot baseline; only hair and expression change. Color setup: natural medium warm skin and medium chestnut-brown hair with readable highlights and shadows. Keep these colors clean and visually separable so the game can tint them. Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background in every cell. Composition: generous transparent padding around each figure, no figure crossing cell boundaries, no cropping, no overlaps. Constraints: preserve the exact Apprentice outfit and identity from the reference; one and only one character per cell; exact 3x3 ordering; high-quality clean silhouette; no checkerboard baked into the pixels. Avoid: grid lines, labels, text, numbers, icons, scenery, ground shadows, particles, extra weapons, duplicate limbs, costume changes, borders, watermark.
